# go-modern-strings-clone

**Since:** Go 1.20

## Summary

Use strings.Clone to copy a string without retaining shared backing memory.

## Details

strings.Clone forces a string copy.
Use it when retaining a small string derived from a much larger string would otherwise keep the larger backing memory alive.

## Examples

### Before

```go
copied := string([]byte(s))
```

### After

```go
copied := strings.Clone(s)
```
